name: Celestial Spells
description:
The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Celestial Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Aid, Cure Wounds, Guiding Bolt, Lesser Restoration, Light, Sacred Flame

Level 5: Daylight, Revivify

Level 7: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire

Level 9: Greater Restoration, Summon Celestial
